# Environmental_Modification_Signal

## Definition
A stigmergic signal deposited in the shared environment (e.g., network state) that influences future agent actions without explicit messaging. Reduces communication overhead in iNEST systems, enabling low-latency, implicit coordination across neuromorphic computing nodes.
